fusions.name: Every Arm Swings
fusions.desc: Swings blades in every direction at once, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Many-Armed Grip
fusions.desc: Grips the target and chops it 3 times, each strike dealing 5 damage, then stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Left Behind Still Swinging
fusions.desc: A severed arm keeps fighting for 12 seconds, striking an enemy within 4 tiles for 5 damage every 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Arm Over Arm
fusions.desc: Every hit you land builds a stack on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you move and attack 4% faster per stack (29% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
